content.dlg.curator.curator-root.opt.0.label: 念一条给我听。
content.dlg.curator.curator-root.text: 这厅里每一只展柜都有一条标签，每一条标签都念给谁听过。
content.dlg.factor.factor-root.opt.0.label: 它值多少？
content.dlg.factor.factor-root.text: 柜台上的每样都标了价。绿宝石是厅里的，不是我的。
content.dlg.marshal.marshal-root.opt.0.label: 让我看看。
content.dlg.marshal.marshal-root.text: 从这上面看，整座厅是一幅画。
content.dlg.warden.warden-root.opt.0.label: 清空了吗？
content.dlg.warden.warden-root.text: 点起的兵在这里列过队，又没有站住。
content.fx.sc.east-door.1.narrate: 东门向后退开。近厅只隔一间了。
content.fx.trig.east-door-wrong-side.0.narrate: 东门无法从这一侧打开。
content.npc.curator.name: 馆长
content.npc.factor.name: 经纪
content.npc.marshal.name: 典礼官
content.npc.warden.name: 守望者
content.obj.far-hall.clear-the-muster.hint: 守望者在远侧看着那道墙。
content.obj.far-hall.clear-the-muster.title: 清空点兵
content.obj.far-hall.climb-the-loft.title: 登上夹层
content.obj.far-hall.reach-the-end.title: 从远门离开
content.obj.near-hall.hear-the-curator.title: 听馆长讲
content.obj.near-hall.reach-the-counter.title: 走到柜台
content.obj.near-hall.read-the-label.title: 在案前读一段标签
content.quest.far-hall.goal: 越过那道墙，清空点起的兵，登上夹层，再从远门离开。
content.quest.near-hall.goal: 读完近厅和它旁边的柜台，挣得穿过铁栅之墙的那几道门。
content.world.outro: 厅中每一只展柜都已读过。
content.world.title: 陈列厅（推导版）

source.dlg.curator.curator-root.opt.0.label: Read me one.
source.dlg.curator.curator-root.text: Every case in this hall has a label, and every label is read to somebody.
source.dlg.factor.factor-root.opt.0.label: What is it worth?
source.dlg.factor.factor-root.text: Everything on the counter is priced. The emeralds are the hall's, not mine.
source.dlg.marshal.marshal-root.opt.0.label: Show me.
source.dlg.marshal.marshal-root.text: From up here the whole hall is one picture.
source.dlg.warden.warden-root.opt.0.label: Is it cleared?
source.dlg.warden.warden-root.text: The muster formed up here and did not stay formed.
source.fx.sc.east-door.1.narrate: The east door draws back. The near hall is one room away now.
source.fx.trig.east-door-wrong-side.0.narrate: The east door does not open from this side.
